name: Maharashtra regional solar scouting extent
source: State boundary should be supplied by an approved administrative-boundary dataset; bbox is used only for acquisition planning

building_geometry.strategy: download intersecting S2 level-4 shards, filter by approved Maharashtra boundary, preserve source tile and record keys

building_height.strategy: sample official Temporal v1 height/presence rasters at candidate centroids and preserve missingness

terrain.strategy: download intersecting GLO-30 COG tiles, mosaic/clip to the approved boundary, checksum every input and derivative

solar_resource.strategy: export only the Maharashtra boundary/tiles permitted by the account terms; record export date, resolution and license

limitations: The planning bbox is not an administrative boundary and must not be used for scoring until an approved Maharashtra boundary is supplied.
Statewide Open Buildings and Copernicus downloads are large; acquisition must be staged and checksummed, not committed to Git.
Global Solar Atlas export access and terms must be verified before redistribution or automated serving.
